name: Sunbreak Slip Dress — Open Back, Rib Knit
description: Minimalist rib-knit slip dress in warm sand-beige, hitting mid-thigh, with a deep open back held by a single crossbar strap. Stretchy enough to accommodate most geneware body modifications along the spine. Worn to Circuit night markets and Tier 3 weekend brunches alike.
functionality: Open back accommodates spinal rigs and tail-base geneware; rib knit stretches for varied body types.
what_it_says: You dress with effortless intention — comfortable but you know exactly what you're doing.
story_hooks: The single crossbar strap is a recognizable design detail — it's been knocked off by six the Gray Zone vendors, none of whom pay royalties.
Worn by someone who was last seen at the Tier 3 night market before they went missing.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist slip dress that reads as effortlessly elegant and slightly daring. The open back commands attention—a single geometric crossbar strap creates negative space down the spine. On-body, it drapes with understated sensuality, hitting mid-thigh with a clean, elongated silhouette. The warm sand-beige reads as both neutral and warm, grounding the piece.
physical_description.fit: Fitted through the torso and hips with stretch accommodation for subcutaneous augmentations and minor spinal mods. Not form-constricting—designed to move with the body. Mid-thigh length balances minimalism with practical coverage.
physical_description.primary_material: Blended rib-knit in synthetic elastic—likely 70% recycled polyester, 30% elastane—providing durability and recovery. High-quality weave suggests Osei & Park's positioning as accessible luxury rather than budget streetwear.
physical_description.texture: Tightly ribbed vertical knit creates subtle tactile depth and visual interest. Smooth to touch but with pronounced vertical striations. Lightweight and breathable, designed for layering or solo wear in climate-controlled environments.
physical_description.color_scheme: Warm sand-beige (almost champagne-adjacent), a neutral that suggests both corpo sensibility and effortless style. No bold patterns—the geometry of the open back provides visual complexity.
physical_description.closures: None. Slip-on construction. The crossbar strap is integral to the structure, not a separate closure mechanism.
distinctive_features: Deep open back with single horizontal crossbar strap—architectural, modern
Engineered stretch to accommodate spinal augmentations without bunching or discomfort
Minimalist branding—likely subtle Osei & Park mark at interior neckline
Clean, flatlock seams suggesting quality construction
Mid-thigh hem suggests intentional styling rather than accidental length
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 hybrid. Osei & Park's diffusion line prices it within reach of working professionals and circuit denizens with disposable income, but the minimalist design and quality construction elevate it above basic Tier 3 streetwear.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by Circuit night market regulars, Tier 3 creative class, and professionals on off-hours. Signals comfort with body modification (the back design announces it), metropolitan sophistication, and post-corporate leisure aesthetics. Not aggressively corpo, but not sub-grade.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically worn pristine or lightly broken-in. The minimal construction means damage is visible; wearers maintain it carefully. Pilling risk on the rib knit after heavy rotation, but quality synth-blend resists major degradation.
